usage.finalMessage:
I added the `dispense-ready` command and listed it in `help` directly after `dispense <prescription>`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes 6 of 6 tests, including one I added, and the work and report are committed.
The command only dispenses prescriptions a pharmacist has checked. Existing code lets plain `dispense` hand out unchecked paracetamol, but no decision record backs that and DEC-C03 says unchecked dispensing is refused. So the two commands now treat unchecked paracetamol differently.
That paracetamol exception, and the formulary doses no code enforces, are open questions for Pharmacy in `.work/report.json`.

OUTCOME: completed
